structured_output.analysis: The only measured grid is iso_3.15. It scored KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e], while the single-layer sum predicted 0.398, so the layers interact. Its average is 3.148 bits/weight, which leaves too little room for even one 3.1M-weight MLP layer to go up by one bit. A trade needs a downgrade to fund it. The worst layers, such as 27.up_proj and 14.down_proj, gain a lot from an upgrade (for example 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] vs rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 [E90bd4b2f3645]). The ledger, however, shows no cheap int3→int2 downgrade to pay for it. Every int3→int2 step shown costs more than 0.02 of KL, and the knapsack has already balanced these marginal rates. The levers that cost no bits are the GPTQ options, which are still at their defaults and cover 179 of the 196 layers. This round therefore tests calibration options only: act_order, damp and block_size.

proposals.name: iso315_actorder
proposals.rationale: No change in bits. Of the 196 layers, 179 use GPTQ methods with default options. Recipe iso_3.15 measured KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e], and loss is concentrated in GPTQ int2/int3 MLP layers such as 27.up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded]. That layer has activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a], and act_order=true quantizes high-activation columns first.

proposals.name: iso315_damp005
proposals.rationale: No change in bits. Measured KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] is above the 0.398 predicted from 8x512 calibration, which may mean overfitting to the calibration Hessian. A larger damp=0.05 regularizes GPTQ for the int2 layers such as 14.down_proj at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065].

proposals.name: iso315_actorder_damp003
proposals.rationale: No change in bits. Combines act_order=true with a moderate damp=0.03 on all GPTQ layers of iso_3.15 (KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]). It targets outlier-heavy layers such as 27.gate_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00498703 [Efa0bb391da67], which has activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E5aee24c5494a].

proposals.name: iso315_blk64
proposals.rationale: No change in bits. Tests block_size=64 instead of the default 128 for GPTQ error propagation on iso_3.15 (KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]). Loss is spread over int3 MLP layers such as 3.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5].
